name: Volume Occupancy Map Skip
definition: A technique to skip empty voxels (e.g., sparse clouds) by using a preprocessed Volume Occupancy Map. If the current voxel is detected as empty, traversal jumps directly to the next non-empty voxel.
summary: Volume Occupancy Map Skip accelerates ray traversal in sparse volumetric data by using a preprocessed binary mask to jump directly between non-empty voxels, avoiding density evaluations in empty space.
